reviews.text: Well done! My giant white poodle was groomed to perfection. And the dogs aren't stressed, which is perhaps even more important!

I brought my miniature poodle today. She's already been washed at home, but her tail and paws are quite matted, as I couldn't untangle them at home. She had a lot of hair when she started grooming, and I asked for a precise cut. I have to be honest, I wasn't entirely convinced about taking her to a groomer because I was afraid whoever I entrusted her to would be a disaster, based on past experiences with other groomers. However, it was a great experience with them. They gave me back my perfect dog, with exactly the cut I requested, and perfectly untamed in all areas. I will definitely be back 100%.
Very good grooming. They love dogs and treat them with care. I recommend them.
They're great. Even though my poodle had long hair, they did a great job. I highly recommend them.

Best groomer for my poodle!! Even when I brought him in terrible conditions, they always work miracles!! The grooming style is very beautiful and precise. I've tried many other places and always had disappointing results, sometimes even paying more. Highly recommended!!
